title: At a post office
topic: Two people are talking at a post office. What will the woman do next?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 郵便局で二人が話しています。女の人は、次に何をしますか。
turns.translation: Two people are talking at a post office. What will the woman do next?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: この箱を大阪の姉に送りたいです。中には服が入っています。今日送れますか。
turns.translation: I'd like to send this box to my older sister in Osaka. There are clothes inside. Can I send it today?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: はい。箱はこのままで大丈夫です。でも、ここに住所を書いてください。
turns.translation: Yes. The box is fine as it is. But please write the address here.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 住所はもう箱の横に書きました。この紙にも同じ住所を書くんですか。
turns.translation: I've already written the address on the side of the box. Should I write the same address on this form too?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: はい。上にお姉さんの住所と名前、下にご自分の住所と名前をお願いします。
turns.translation: Yes. Your sister's address and name at the top, and your own address and name at the bottom, please.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 分かりました。お金は今、払いますか。財布をかばんから出しますね。
turns.translation: I see. Do I pay now? I'll get my wallet out of my bag.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: お金は後で結構です。まず、その紙を書いてください。ペンはこちらにあります。
turns.translation: You can pay later. First, please fill out that form. There is a pen here.

options.label: お金を払います。
options.rationale: She proposes paying now, but the clerk says to pay later.

options.label: 新しい箱を買います。
options.rationale: The clerk says the existing box is fine.

options.label: 姉に電話します。
options.rationale: Her sister is the recipient; no phone call is requested.

options.label: 紙に住所と名前を書きます。
options.translation: Write addresses and names on the form.
options.rationale: The clerk repeats this as the action to do first.

explanation: The address already on the box does not replace the form. The immediate task is filling out the recipient and sender information; payment follows.
